name: my-buddy
description: A small pixel-art buddy above the prompt that acts out what the session is doing.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long one API response keeps the prompt cache warm: 60 on the 1-hour tier (the default), 5 on the 5-minute tier.

keepWarm.title: Keep the prompt cache warm
keepWarm.description: While you are away, send a tiny keep-alive prompt just before the cache goes cold, up to 5 times in a row, then compact the session and stop. Override per session with /buddy keepwarm.
